title: Renewable Content, REC Retirement and Green Marketing Features of the Beacon Ridge C&I Structures
content:
Among Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, only Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable carries renewable content beyond the state standard. The renewable share is the share of the facility's usage matched with renewable energy certificates (RECs) beyond what the state standard already requires.

| Structure | Renewable content beyond the state standard | Certificates retired | Annual certificate retirement statement | Renewable logo license (green marketing kit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 0% | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 0% | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 0% | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 0% | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 0% | none | no | no |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 100% | Green-e Energy certified PJM wind RECs | yes | yes |

## Points of reading

- A facility on Fixed All-In Renewable has 100% of its usage matched with Green-e Energy certified PJM wind RECs beyond the state standard, receives an annual certificate retirement statement and receives the renewable logo license.
- The other five structures retire no certificates beyond the state standard, issue no retirement statement and carry no logo license.
- Fixed All-In and Fixed All-In Renewable share the same fixed all-in contract structure; the renewable features are what set the Renewable structure apart in this table.
